Filter the output by the specified properties.
Defaults to no filtering and can be multiple values.

options.name: --from
options.description:
The start date to use for the costs. Defaults to
the first day of the previous month.

options.name: --metric
options.description:
The metric to use for the costs. Defaults to
ActualCost. (ActualCost, AmortizedCost)

options.name: --others-cutoff
options.description:
The number of items to show before collapsing the
rest into an 'Others' item.

options.name: --output
options.description:
The output format to use. Defaults to Console
(Console, Json, JsonC, Text, Markdown, Csv)

options.name: --priceApiBaseAddress
options.description:
The base address for the Price API. Defaults to
https://prices.azure.com/

options.name: --query
options.description:
JMESPath query string, applicable for the Json
output only. See http://jmespath.org/ for more information and examples.

options.name: --resource-group
options.description:
The resource group to scope the request to. Need
to be used in combination with the subscription id.

options.name: --skipHeader
options.description:
Skip header creation for specific output formats.
Useful when appending the output from multiple runs into one file. Defaults to
false.

options.name: --subscription
options.description:
The subscription id to use. Will try to fetch the
active id if not specified.

options.name: --timeframe
options.description:
The timeframe to use for the costs. Defaults to
BillingMonthToDate. When set to Custom, specify the from and to dates using the
--from and --to options

options.name: --to
options.description:
The end date to use for the costs. Defaults to the
current date.

options.name: --useUSD
options.description:
Force the use of USD for the currency. Defaults to
false to use the currency returned by the API.
